title: One-Stop MCP server manifest
description: One declarative file per downstream MCP server (servers/<id>.yaml). Mirrors src/types.ts; the hand-written validator in src/manifest.ts is the CI source of truth and test/manifest.test.ts keeps the two in step. Editor completion: add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/manifest.schema.json` as the first line of the YAML.

id.description: Lowercase-kebab, permanent, and equal to the file name without .yaml (servers/notion.yaml -> notion).

category.description: What the server is for. list_servers can filter on these, and low-confidence find_tools suggests them to browse.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the server reads and writes. Feeds the router.

transport.description: How the gateway reaches the server.

command.description: Executable to spawn, e.g. npx or uvx.

args.description: Arguments. Pin packages to an exact version.

env.description: Static, non-secret environment for the child. Credentials are injected from auth.env, never written here.

headers.description: Static, non-secret request headers. Credentials go through auth.header, never here.

auth.description: How a user authorises the server. Absent = none.

env.description: stdio only: env var the credential (API key or OAuth access token) is injected into.

header.description: streamable-http only: header that carries the credential. Default Authorization.

prefix.description: streamable-http only: prefix for the header value. Default "Bearer " when the header is Authorization, else empty.

keyUrl.description: api_key: where the user creates or re-issues a key. Shown on the guided key-entry page.

rotation.description: api_key: id of a provider adapter that can rotate the key by API. Absent = guided rotation.

authorizationUrl.description: oauth2 without MCP auth discovery (most stdio servers): the authorization endpoint. Absent on an HTTP server = discover per the MCP authorization spec.

tokenUrl.description: oauth2 without MCP auth discovery: the token endpoint. Must be given together with authorizationUrl.

clientId.description: oauth2: public OAuth client id (PKCE). A client secret, if a provider needs one, lives in the vault, not here.

routing.description: Example utterances that power routing (the semantic index).

examples.description: 3-5 things a user might say that this server should handle.

tools.description: Per-tool utterances keyed by tool name. Every key must exist in catalog/<id>.json (checked by npm run validate).

check.description: What the PR probe and health checks exercise.

homepage.description: The server's documentation or project page.
